content: Claude Code UserPromptSubmit injects additionalContext and cannot replace the prompt. Default timeout is 30s; a timeout discards context and the prompt still proceeds. Copilot SDK onUserPromptSubmitted can replace the prompt or add additionalContext; docs say preserve user intent. Cursor beforeSubmitPrompt can only continue or block, not inject a plan. postToolUse can add additional_context. The durable host-bridge pattern is: the hook injects a pointer, the agent turn writes the tracker.
